**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 18 of the agreement satisfies the INSURANCE rule at the **preferred** position, not merely the fallback:

| Preferred requirement | Document (§ 18.1–18.2) |
|---|---|
| CGL USD 1M/occurrence, 2M aggregate | ✅ Exact match |
| Professional (E&O) USD 2M | ✅ Exact match |
| Cyber/privacy USD 5M (vendor processes Customer Data) | ✅ Exact match |
| Workers' compensation as required by law | ✅ Present |
| Certificates on request | ✅ § 18.2 |

The clause also contains several terms that run in our favor beyond the playbook ask — employer's liability of USD 1M, a reputable-insurer standard, coverage primary to Customer's insurance where commercially customary, advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, and an express statement that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities (preserving the indemnity and liability provisions). Coverage is also maintained for one year post-term, matching the model language's tail.

Consistent with the classification guidance, I did not flag anything here: the clause is at the preferred position and the extra provisions benefit Northwind, so redlining would only risk reopening favorable terms.
